Subject: Audit pack request for Marketplace integration (subprocessors + KMS)

Hi Camila,

As part of our onboarding and risk review for the FinOps Marketplace integration, our security team has asked us to provide a consolidated audit pack covering third-party dependencies and key management boundaries. Specifically we need: 
- A current subprocessor roster (roles, contract start/end, countries where processing occurs)
- A KMS/key ownership diagram showing which keys are customer-managed vs Redwood-managed and any HSM usage
- A concise dataflow map for the integration (ingress, retention, egress, masking/encryption points)
- SIG Lite or CAIQ pointers if available and a SOC 2 scope statement

We'd appreciate receiving the pack within 7 business days so we can close out our procurement check. If any of the items need a bit more time, please flag dependencies (e.g., redaction for PII in attachments) and an expected ETA.

Also, our auditor (cc'd) may follow up with a few clarifying questions — happy to open a short call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Daniel Hayes
Security & Risk, FinOps

Attachments requested: subprocessor CSV, KMS diagram, SIG/CAIQ export, SOC 2 scope summary

1) Subprocessor roster with role + country + contract window (CSV) — Laura, can you pull the canonical list and include contract start/end and whether DPA is in place?

4) SIG Lite / CAIQ guidance and SOC 2 scope summary — I will export the SIG-lite PDF and SOC 2 scope note, but I may need Laura's help to confirm scope of systems included in this integration.

Target: compile and send audit pack to FinOps by EOD Friday (2026-07-03). If anything blocks that ETA, post here and propose an alternate date.

Jonas — if there are any elevated access patterns (e.g., cross-region key replication or shared HSM tenancy), call it out in the diagram and a short bulleted note.

I will be the responder. FinOps security is cc'd; include them if you need clarification.

Hi — attached is the updated KMS keyflow (kms_keyflow_v2.png) and a short note below. Attachment stub: kms_keyflow_v2.png (PNG, 1.2 MB)
Summary / callouts:
- Customer data keys: customer_master_key (CMK) for tenant-level encryption — can be customer-managed (BYOK) or Redwood-managed.
- HSM usage: Our KM service uses HSM-backed KMS in region us-west-2 for CRYPTO materials. HSM logs are segmented and forwarded to our audit logs (see SOC 2 evidence).
- Cross-region replication: Key material is not replicated; rather, wrapped DEKs are transferred to regional services as needed.
- Limited operational access: Vault operators have emergency access under break-glass procedures; all such access is logged and requires two-party approval.

I've also attached a short TSV (redwood_subprocessors_2023-2026.csv) stub listing third parties that interact with Marketplace flows marked by processing role (storage, telemetry, compute, kms). Laura — please confirm contract dates on the CSV.

Attachments included (stubs):
- redwood_subprocessors_2023-2026.csv (roles, country, contract start/end, DPA flag)
